about: Wendy S. Goffe is a top-rated attorney who practices law in Seattle, Washington. Wendy Goffe focuses on Estate Planning & Probate issues. Additionally, she also helps clients with legal issues in the following areas of law: Nonprofit Organizations.

Wendy Goffe received Super Lawyers designation for 2001 - 2026. She was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
She became a licensed attorney in 1992. Before practicing law, she attended law school at University of Washington School of Law and graduated in 1992.
